== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Alazar, also known as [[The Perfected|the Perfected]] Mage, is a powerful figure associated with the [[Karoshan Empire]]. He commands a Mage Corps and possesses significant magical [[Authority|authority]], as his subordinates require his direct confirmation before they can execute large-scale preparations or casting. Alazar utilizes advanced tools such as an ancient [[scrying mirror]] to monitor the state of the [[Aether]] across distant systems. His presence is formidable; he is capable of matching powerful enemy spells, and his absence from a fleet can make certain magical maneuvers appear suicidal. The term "[[Perfected]]" refers to a state of being that provides enhanced resistance to magic and ensures an individual lacks deficiencies in training, equipment, or magical ability.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Alazar is a mage with the capability to match the spells of his enemies. He may also possess access to various magical treasures belonging to the royal court.}}
